I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the incident messages in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. Priyanka reported that label printing had stalled across Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

Nothing Tobias can see gives Southgate's address or city, and there are no Tansley Parcel account files in the share. I told him so and suggested he ask Priyanka for the full site details. I didn't search other channels, because he could only see what's in his own.
